Title: Azure Database Migration Service hybrid mode is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Database Migration Service hybrid mode is now in preview. It uses a migration worker hosted on-premises together with an instance of Database Migration Service running in the cloud (the “cloud service”) to manage database migrations. Database Migration Service hybrid mode is especially useful for scenarios in which there’s a lack of site-to-site connectivity between the on-premises network and Azure, or limited site-to-site connectivity bandwidth.

For more information, see our service documentation.
